lines.C01: [irritated, sharp] Marcel, down! {{pause=0.3}} [haughty, regal] Bow. Lower. Good. {{pause=0.3}} [smug, drawling] Welcome to Versailles, my friends. [delighted, self-admiring] Yes, I'm that handsome. {{pause=0.4}} [sneering, amused] Try not to faint.
lines.C02: [conspiratorial, proud] Some mornings, a hundred people watch me wake up. {{pause=0.2}} The ceremony is called the rising. {{pause=0.4}} [smug, with a soft laugh] I call it opening night.
lines.C03: [dry, bored] The doctor's here, the surgeon's here, and nobody came to see them. {{pause=0.4}} [commanding, then breathy with delight] Look at me instead. {{pause=0.5}} [swooning] Magnificent, no?

lines.C05: [smug] It makes me look taller, they say. {{pause=0.3}} [lofty] I wouldn't know. I never look down. {{pause=0.5}} [soft sigh of delight] What a face, though.
lines.C06: [theatrical, savouring] White, grey, a little powder. {{pause=0.4}} [prophetic, grandly] One day, everybody will wear this. {{pause=0.4}} [mock-modest, chuckles] I'm just early.
lines.C07: [regal, bored] Bow. Lower. Good. {{pause=0.4}} [delighted, preening] White suits me, doesn't it? {{pause=0.3}} [arrogant] Everything does.
lines.C08: [contemptuous] A hundred people in this room, and only one worth looking at. {{pause=0.5}} [tender, adoring] Me, {{pause=0.3}} [snorts a laugh] obviously.
lines.C09: [sharp, scandalised] Lower. {{pause=0.3}} Lower. {{pause=0.2}} [outraged whisper] Careful, that's a hat. {{pause=0.3}} [recovering haughtiness] Eyes on me, not on the hat.
